parameters.name: FaultLocation
parameters.description: Specifies the location of where to create and keep the logs. Can either be a relative path or file within the {{param|#.StoragePath}} location.

parameters.name: LastInstruction
parameters.description: The last instruction executed when the Kernel fault was triggered.

parameters.name: TimeStamp
parameters.description: The time when the Kernel fault was registered.

parameters.name: FirmwareVersion
parameters.description: The firmware version that triggered the Kernel fault.

parameters.name: ProcessName
parameters.description: The name of the process that was active while the kernel fault occurred.

parameters.name: Reason
parameters.description: The reason why the kernel fault occurred.

object.description: Each table entry represents a Kernel fault that is stored on the device.
